sections.description:
Uncoder Elements is a powerful Elementor addon that brings useful widgets, design controls, performance tools, and WooCommerce-ready enhancements into one lightweight plugin.

It includes 10+ creative widgets, mega menu support, custom animations, advanced Elementor controls, 7000+ SVG optimized icons, WebP generation, database optimization, loading speed improvements, and more.

Whether you are building landing pages, business websites, WooCommerce stores, blogs, or custom Elementor layouts, Uncoder Elements helps you design faster, customize better, and keep your website optimized.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Uncoder Elements plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin.
  5. Select the uncoder-elements.zip file and click Install Now.
  6. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
  7. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated to use the Elementor widgets and controls.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • New: Disable Emoji Script and Disable WP Embed switches in Site Settings → Tools → Optimization (off by default; One-Click Optimization turns them on).
  • Fixed: Page cache could store pages already compressed by another plugin or the host and serve them broken to logged-out visitors in every browser. Such pages are no longer cached, existing broken entries repair themselves, and gzip negotiation is stricter (honours gzip;q=0, never sends a second Content-Encoding). Purge the cache once after updating.
  • Fixed: Simple Accordion “Section ID” items now show their content (the ID was looked up with a stray leading hyphen); IDs containing dots, colons or brackets work; missing or duplicated IDs are explained in the editor; nested accordions open independently; typing in a form inside a panel no longer toggles it. Pages that used a leading “-” ID as a workaround keep working.
  • Fixed: Link Custom Attributes (aria-label, data-*, …) now render on the Icon Box image link, Image Accordion buttons and Marquee image links; the Marquee editor preview matches the front end.
  • Improved: No PHP warning from the page-cache drop-in under WP-CLI and cron.
  • New: The Plugins screen shows the bundled Elementor Pro version next to the plugin version.
  • Refreshed Uncoder admin menu icon.

2.0.0

  • All-new modular architecture
  • 3 new widgets: Animated Word Roller, Image Accordion, Stacked Slider
  • New Uncoder admin menu with a full Site Settings app (Settings + Tools: Optimization, Delay JS, WebP, Database Optimizer, Import/Export, Endpoint Manager)
  • Uncoder Icons: Nexa + Ekit merged into one 1,007-glyph library with automatic one-time migration of existing content
  • New: Form input masks (intl. phone), responsive Custom CSS device tabs, frontend edit buttons, Polylang theme-builder templates, light logo, meta description module, custom JS / header / footer code, heading scroll-fill, one-click optimization
  • Improved: page cache 1.2.2 (atomic writes, better bypasses), hardened SVG sanitizer, rebuilt auto-animation engine, safer cache purge

1.0.7.4 – 01 June 2026

  • NEW: HTML Disk Cache Added (Elementor > Settings > Performance > HTML Disk Cache).

1.0.7.3 – 28 May 2026

  • Minor bug fixes and code improvements.

1.0 – 09 June 2025

  • Initial release.
